honesty_rules: FDL1/FDL2 are NEVER bundled and NEVER guessed. On every secure-boot Unisoc chip the BootROM only accepts the signed stock FDL from that model's own PAC firmware; MEER harvests them from a user-supplied PAC (core/spd_fdl.prepare_fdl).

FDL load addresses (Base) are per-FIRMWARE values read from the PAC's own XML. They are not per-chip constants, except the worked examples documented in the upstream spd_dump README (Tiger T310, UMS9117/T117, SC653x feature phones). Any other base written here would be invented — so none is.
codename = the Unisoc BSP/kernel platform name (e.g. UMS9230, SharkL3) where a public source grounds it; otherwise the string UNKNOWN with the reason in notes.
boot_vid_pid is the SPRD download gadget 1782:4D00 for every row (1782:4D01 is the second diag interface; both are mapped to SPD mode in src/core/device_watch.py).
name: MEER Tool Pro — Unisoc/SPD chip table
purpose: Per-chip public data for the SPD/Unisoc module: platform codename, FDL naming pattern inside PAC firmware, download-mode boot key, boot-port USB IDs, and spd_dump support status. Consumed as data (same pattern as tools/mdm-models.json) — no FDL binaries are bundled anywhere in MEER Tool Pro.
